note: Description taken from Holmgren's 1910 original description of Eutermes Guayanae (in German), including the soldier and worker; alate unknown; type locality British Guiana (Guayana). The original is in German and the BHL scan OCR is only moderate: decimal points are often misread as commas or colons and some measurement digits are blurred; blurred values are not cited. The species was then placed in Eutermes and is now in Nasutitermes.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: A small species; soldier body length 3.67 mm, head length 1.65—1.85 mm, nasus long and conical; head capsule dark brown, not very glossy, the nasus tip and the region around the antennae paler; frons only sparsely covered with long bristles on the sides; smaller than the next species, E. 15-articulatus (head width 1.55—1.65 mm).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown, not very glossy; nasus tip and region around the antennae slightly paler; antennae rusty brown, annulate; anterior margin of the pronotum brown; abdominal tergites rusty yellowish brown to rusty yellow, sternites and legs rusty yellow to straw-yellow. Frons and vertex sparsely covered with long bristles, the sides of the head also bristled. Head with a long conical pointed nasus, frontal outline almost a straight line, the elevation at the base of the nasus distinct; antennae 14-segmented: the basal segment equal to the sum of the next two, segment 3 variable in length (equal to or slightly longer than segment 2), segment 4 equal to or slightly longer than segment 2, segment 5 equal to segment 2 but shorter than segment 6, lengthening gradually from segment 6 on. Posterior margin of the pronotum weakly arched, anterior margin not concave. Abdominal tergites smooth, with a row of erect bristles at the posterior margin, the sternites additionally densely covered with short hairs. Measurements: body length 3.67 mm; head length 1.65—1.85 mm (most frequent 1.79—1.80 mm); head width 0.95—1.19 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Vertex surface dark brown, the head capsule sutures, anterior corners of the transverse band, region around the antennae, antennae, postclypeus, labrum and mandible bases white-yellow, the rest of the body white-yellow to rusty yellow. Bristles of head and thorax very sparse, abdominal tergites sparse, sternites denser, both with marginal bristle rows. Head shape as usual, the head capsule sutures very distinct; the transverse suture wider at the sides than in the middle; frontal marks long triangular; base of the postclypeus slightly shorter than half its width, rather convex. Antennae 14-segmented: segment 3 about equal to segment 2, segment 4 slightly shorter, segment 5 indistinctly shorter than segment 4. Anterior and posterior lobes of the pronotum almost as high as the rest.
